# The first Account Hub option observer restores an unset cache during initial rebuild

The original observer rebuild always assigns this.value from this.#cachedValue after cloning options. The field has no initializer, and the first setup path has not cached a selection yet. This can supply an unset value even when a cloned option carries selected. Fixed accepted code checks whether the rebuilt options contain a selection before restoring the cache. This static phase difference is separate from the later backout cause and has no reproduced UI result.

Scope: Account Hub select initialization.
